name: Alpine grasses & sedges
desc: Short-turf meadow plants above the treeline, grazed by wild and domestic hoofed animals and by marmots.
about: Poaceae ( poh-AY-see-e(y)e), also called Gramineae ( grə-MIN-ee-e(y)e), is a large and nearly ubiquitous family of monocotyledonous flowering plants commonly known as true grasses.
